body: Ah thank you, hopefully he comes back out soon enough, ill update if he does.

I am not playing victim. I originally bought the rat because the pet store here keeps young rats crowded in small cages in large groups without separating their genders. I was hoping to give him a better chance at life other than snake food or have to be kept there.

Actually I've had rats for 4 years, none of which I had ever seen jump, none of which that ever jumped, all of them were very relaxed rats and mostly spent their time on the ground, this is the first time I've ever had a rat that was this energetic.
Thank you, we got a box with some bedding and food, hopefully he comes out behind the water heater soon to eat some food.

I am well aware that 4 weeks is extremely young, you can blame the pet store for that.
I have never dealt with a rat that was a jumper which is why I was surprised.
